en: Take a full ritual bath (ghusl) on Friday before going to the prayer.
Wear perfume (for men) and your best, cleanest clothes.
Go to the mosque early, walking if possible, to sit close and attain the full reward.
Listen attentively to the khutbah and avoid speaking, even to advise someone to be quiet.
Recite Surah Al-Kahf on Friday — the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Surah Al-Kahf on Friday will have light that shines for him between the two Fridays."

ar: تَحَرِّي سَاعَةِ الْإِجَابَةِ آخِرَ النَّهَارِ قَبْلَ الْمَغْرِبِ
en: Seek the hour of acceptance — the last part of the day, before Maghrib — and devote it to dua.

ar: تَقْلِيمُ الْأَظْفَارِ وَإِزَالَةُ مَا يَحْتَاجُ إِزَالَتَهُ مِنَ الشَّعْرِ
en: Trim your nails and remove excess hair if needed, as part of preparing for the day.

ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
en: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad — the Prophet ﷺ said: "Increase your sending of blessings upon me on Friday, for your blessings are presented to me."

ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ الْمُبَارَكِ خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، وَأَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ
en: O Allah, I ask You on this blessed day for the good of this world and the next, and that You grant me from Your great bounty.

ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
en: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no deity but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
